Update19 October 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
📜Patch Notes - October 19, 2026
Small patch, bringing the Hallowtide spirit back as a few Festivals begin anew!

🎃 Hallowtide Festivals

  • The following events have started and will run until the 4th of November!
    • 🎃 Hallowtide Festival <Solis, Two Crowns>
    • 🧹 Mirage Broom Race <Mirage Isle>

Primal Anthalon Changes

  • Increased duration of Ritual Summoning by +5 seconds to compensate for Dread Sentry spawn invulnerability.
  • Rot will now more reliably cast throughout the encounter and the animation has been changed to help with visibility.
  • The Exeloch purification growth timer has been removed. The purification will now phase to Primal Mana Tower on the days that it spawns, and become purified at the end of the encounter regardless of the outcome.
  • Increased damage multiplier of Shadow Dart from 3 to 6.
  • Increased the reset range of Primal Anthalon by an additional 50 meters.

Misc. Changes

  • Radiant Insulating Lens (Ice Block) now disables incoming healing instead of making it damage the user while active.
  • Radiant Mettle has been changed from a 3 second cooldown on granting stacks to a 0.5 second cooldown.
  • Radiant Mettle's 3% spell evasion per stack has been phased out, instead replaced by 1.5% magic damage reduction per stack and -100 fixed damage reduction to all types per stack.
    • Spell evasion is an un-used stat in the original Archeage, and was not functioning properly against many skills in the game. We've opted to replace it entirely, rather than fight with it.
  • Radiant Mettle has had it's duration increased from 9s -> 12s
  • Radiant Mana Force has had it's target eligibility tightened.
  • Hollow Critical Discord now properly targets it's AOE around the player, not their target.
  • Hollow Renewal now originates the AOE erupt from the debuffed target, and not the skill's caster.
  • Gale Charm no longer breaks the enchanting window, allowing it to be replaced properly.
  • All Charms now apply whether you equip your costume or accessories first.
  • Orange-U-Glad now has the correct tooltip, and boosts by 12%
  • Survey Armor from Taming now has the correct tooltips to show it's % modifier gain.
  • Taming skills now are properly unable to critically heal.
  • More monsters are eligible for spawning Tameable Ants.
  • More monsters are eligible for spawning Tameable Scorpions.
  • Hasla Emerald Weapons have had their imaging issues fixed.
  • The Addon API has had numerous security updates.

== 🎃 Hallowtide Festivals ==
* The following events have started and will run until the 4th of November!
** 🎃 Hallowtide Festival <Solis, Two Crowns>
** 🧹 Mirage Broom Race <Mirage Isle>

== Primal Anthalon Changes ==
* Increased duration of Ritual Summoning by +5 seconds to compensate for Dread Sentry spawn invulnerability.
* Rot will now more reliably cast throughout the encounter and the animation has been changed to help with visibility.
* The Exeloch purification growth timer has been removed. The purification will now phase to Primal Mana Tower on the days that it spawns, and become purified at the end of the encounter regardless of the outcome.
* Increased damage multiplier of Shadow Dart from 3 to 6.
* Increased the reset range of Primal Anthalon by an additional 50 meters.

== Misc. Changes ==
* Radiant Insulating Lens (Ice Block) now disables incoming healing instead of making it damage the user while active.
* Radiant Mettle has been changed from a 3 second cooldown on granting stacks to a 0.5 second cooldown.
* Radiant Mettle's 3% spell evasion per stack has been phased out, instead replaced by 1.5% magic damage reduction per stack and -100 fixed damage reduction to all types per stack.
** Spell evasion is an un-used stat in the original Archeage, and was not functioning properly against many skills in the game. We've opted to replace it entirely, rather than fight with it.
* Radiant Mettle has had it's duration increased from 9s -> 12s
* Radiant Mana Force has had it's target eligibility tightened.
* Hollow Critical Discord now properly targets it's AOE around the player, not their target.
* Hollow Renewal now originates the AOE erupt from the debuffed target, and not the skill's caster.
* Gale Charm no longer breaks the enchanting window, allowing it to be replaced properly.
* All Charms now apply whether you equip your costume or accessories first.
* Orange-U-Glad now has the correct tooltip, and boosts by 12%
* Survey Armor from Taming now has the correct tooltips to show it's % modifier gain.
* Taming skills now are properly unable to critically heal.
* More monsters are eligible for spawning Tameable Ants.
* More monsters are eligible for spawning Tameable Scorpions.
* Hasla Emerald Weapons have had their imaging issues fixed.

* The Addon API has had numerous security updates.
